reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified correct. The while loop at peerdas_helpers.nim:50 terminates only when HashSet size equals custody_group_count, but all inserted values are mod 128 (NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS), so the set saturates at 128 unique elements. When peer-reported custody_group_count > 128, the loop condition can never be satisfied, causing an infinite loop. Attacker control: direct. Path type: attacker-triggered. An attacker can trigger this via P2P by advertising custody_group_count=2^32 in peer metadata. The victim node calls checkIntersectingCustody (validator_custody.nim:134) → lookupCgcFromPeer → resolve_columns_from_custody_groups → handle_custody_groups, causing the requesting thread to freeze. Spec reference from 01e_PARTIAL_MANUAL_15_109_190_216.json confirms: 'Peer-reported custody_group_count must be validated against NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS upper bound before use in any loop or data structure sizing. handle_custody_groups must terminate in O(NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS) iterations regardless of the peer-advertised value.' No validation exists on peer-reported values. Severity calibrated per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json: single-peer DoS affecting one victim node = Medium severity per contest rules (>5% network impact threshold not met for single-node freeze).
